host.comparison: Decoded RGBA SHA-256 plus exact dimensions; zero pixel tolerance.

review.method: Main individually viewed every actual artifact PNG, recorded the per-image disposition, and independently decoded every downloaded PNG to verify its cloud candidate digest. No --update-goldens or automatic approval.
